taylor: Quick shout — huge thanks to @nina + infra team for saving the usability session this morning. Staging was on fire and they had it back in about 8 mins. Also, matcha + cookies = hero energy :sparkles: :cookie:

nina: glad it worked out! ended up doing a quick `kubectl scale --replicas=3 deploy/staging-api` then a rolling restart. shoutout to sam for the sticky-note triage too.

sam: lol sticky notes actually helped. also very proud of the tea pouring job :tea: :raised_hands:

joel: can confirm — users kept moving through the flow, no lost tasks. major win. +1 on the cookies :+1:

ops-bot: Incident resolved: staging-api restored to healthy state. Duration: 00:08:12. Report: https://status.redwood.ai/inc/412987 (auto-note)

emma: :tada: nina you're a legend. Treats on me next Tues? vote: cookies or churros? :cookie: :doughnut:

nina: churros please :raised_hands:

taylor: poll time — react with :cookie: for cookies, :doughnut: for churros, or :zzz: for I-need-sleep

sam: :cookie: :cookie:

taylor: OK cookies take it 2-1-1. planning delivery tuesday. thanks again everyone — really saved our session and spirits :heart:
